notes:
Account background: ClearSlate builds an embedded in-app assistant and enterprise search for mid-market SaaS customers. Currently on a competitor LLM API (contracted), exploring transition to Redwood for cost and throughput. Team: CTO (Marco Alvarez), Head of ML (Priya Rao), Product lead (Daniel Kim).

Why Redwood: cost per token + predictable reserved capacity for heavy nightly ingestion/indexing jobs; desire to keep same developer experience during migration (OpenAI-compat). Platform fit: Hosted for quick POC then migrate to Dedicated pool in 2026 H2 with VPC and KMS.

Recent timeline (high level):
- 2025-11-25: Intro call (AE Sofia) — high-level product fit, requirement mapping; customer asked for compatibility with existing OpenAI-based client.
- 2026-01-12: Technical deep-dive with SE (Ethan) — infra diagram review, VPC requirements, SSO/SAML flow. Action: provide sample adapter for OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
- 2026-02-04: Pricing workshop (Sofia + Finance) — ask for committed vs burst pricing scenarios; interested in 12-month reserved pool. Linked doc: pricing_deck_v3.
- 2026-02-18: Hosted POC kickoff (Fireflies id ff_2026-02-18_CSL-team-demo). Goals: 1) Validate prompt parity for top-120 prompt families; 2) Verify embeddings quality for semantic search; 3) Measure p50/p95 latency for chat flows.
- 2026-03-02: Mid-POC technical review with SE — initial parity run: 120 prompt families, ~4% regressions flagged (highest in code-assist/completion tasks). Note: some verbosity differences and tokenization-induced probability shifts. Action: run Redwood Optimize evals + prompt tuning. (Fireflies ff_2026-03-02_se-technical-review).
- 2026-03-10: Security intake completed (SOC2 scope request) — legal drafted DPA, waiting on customer's legal. Ticket RLW-219 opened for SOC2 gap questions.

Technical/POC details:
- Compatibility strategy: customer wants a minimal-change migration path. We proposed an OpenAI-compat adapter library (proxy) + config flags to select model variants. POC uses Redwood-hosted model closest to their incumbent.
- Prompt parity: test harness (120 families) -> automated A/B diffs, human scoring for top-20 failure cases. Current failure modes: hallucination thresholds on long-context code completions, subtle tokenization differences in system prompt handling.
- Regression plan: Redwood Optimize to run rollout evals; canary route to incumbent model for fallback on dev traffic; scheduled weekly regression reports.
- Performance targets: chat p50 < 150ms (short prompt), p95 < 700ms; embeddings throughput target 150 qps for indexing windows; peak concurrency anticipated 400 RPS across product.
- Cost target: reduce per-token inference cost by ~30% vs incumbent across production mix (chat + embeddings).

Procurement/Commercial notes:
- Customer prefers starting with Hosted API (self-serve) to shorten time-to-value. If POC meets parity and security signoff, they will convert to Dedicated (12-month commit) in Q3. Price sensitivity around burst vs committed pricing.
- Finance asked for an example committed SKU and burn-rate model for 100k tokens/day average. Requested a templated commitment quote.

Risks & open items:
- Prompt parity regressions need triage; code-assist regressions may require model variant or prompt engineering.
- SOC2 evidence & DPA signoff timeline (legal) — blocker for Dedicated procurement.
- Networking: need sample VPC peering diagram and egress IP list for customer's firewall team.

Next steps (short):
1) Deliver Hosted POC adapter package and example OpenAI-compat proxy (Ethan) by 2026-03-16.
2) Run Redwood Optimize evals on the 120 prompt families; return human-reviewed report week of 2026-03-23.
3) Provide committed pricing template and sample ARR scenarios (Sofia) by 2026-03-18.
4) Customer legal to return signed DPA or list outstanding items (tracked in SEC-47).

Customer quote (paraphrase): "We want minimal dev friction — if we can flip a flag and keep parity, we'll move fast. But regressions on critical flows (code assist) are showstoppers."

Short CRM fragments/quick log: 
- "POC: hosted adapter up, running against sample dataset (search index)"
- "Finance asked for committed 12mo pricing; pushing for 20% discount tiers"
- "SE: will enable canary routing to incumbent as safety net"

Overall: Strong likelihood to convert if parity + SOC2 cleared. Beta of Dedicated considered Q3 contingent on POC metrics and legal signoff.
